views.markdown: An iPad-style grid app switcher for iPhone. Instead of forcing the iPad switcher style (which broke on iOS 16), it makes SpringBoard build its own native iPad grid switcher — smooth, no artifacts.

- Native iPad-style grid switcher
- Adjustable card size (Extra Small → Large)
- Adjustable spacing (portrait & landscape)
- Adjustable corner radius
- Settings apply live — no respring for most changes
iOS 16, rootless (tested on 16.5 / Dopamine). Not iOS 15.
